predeclared_theorem: G4-full/G1-full/G2-full/G5-full/G6-full gates are predicted to be no-ops on final MAE because x3a_lib.shield() returns a constant action independent of the raw proposal whenever each rule's own predicate is true; verified empirically against the live shield() by test_e1improve_v2_gates.py::test_shield_forces_action_independent_of_raw_proposal (28/28 tests passed, including this one) BEFORE the full grid evaluation was run.
selection_rule: A new gate (or combo-all) is preferred over G6-nervous only if, for >=2 of {ConditionA, B2@16384, B2@24576}, it has strictly lower pooled dev MAE AND zero per-cell regressions >=0.05 vs that checkpoint's ungated baseline. Otherwise G6-nervous is retained unchanged.
decision_notes: No confirmatory seed or held-out profile touched
No retraining; reuses existing E1/E1-Improve-V1 checkpoints unmodified
No new threshold introduced anywhere; every gate predicate is copied verbatim from rl/guardrails.py / x3a_lib.py
